theorems.name: Submission.codim1_minimizing_piece_area_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (V M : Set (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), 1 ≤ m → IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsOpen V → M ⊆ V → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → IsOrientation m M ξ → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ V → C ω = ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ V → μHE[m] (M ∩ W) ≠ ∞ → μHE[m] (M ∩ W) ≤ C.massOn W) → ∀ Z : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Z → HasCompactSupport Z → tsupport Z ⊆ V → ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → μHE[m] (M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ μHE[m] ((fun x => x + t • Z x) '' (M ∩ tsupport Z))
